entities.name: Query Nnr-like enzyme
observations: 516-aa query is 35.7% identical across 99.0% query coverage to reviewed Moorella thermoacetica Nnr (UniProt Q2RGI2; E=1.07e-63), supporting a provisional homolog-based assignment.
Likely bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme: epimerizes R/S NAD(P)HX and dehydrates S-NAD(P)HX using ADP; direct experimental validation for this query is not provided.

entities.name: Q2RGI2 Nnr
observations: Reviewed Moorella thermoacetica protein annotated with EC 4.2.1.136 (ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase) and EC 5.1.99.6 (NAD(P)HX epimerase); annotation notes these functions by similarity.
Reference annotation reports one potassium ion bound per subunit.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: Reference Rhea reactions: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H+ (RHEA:32223); analogous (6S)-NADPHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADPH + H+ (RHEA:32235).
